## What changed

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the checks and real-device tests you ran. Separate automated coverage from hardware observations.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] User-visible changes are recorded under **Unreleased** in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass.
- [ ] Compatibility claims identify the exact device, firmware, browser, and test conditions.
- [ ] Logs and fixtures contain no pair codes, tokens, runtime secrets, peer IDs, private addresses, or device names.
- [ ] The change does not bypass DRM or protected capture.
